name: Destiny or Disaster
source:
In the newest dating show of the season, our Bachelor will be matched with two people they are destined to love – and one they are destined to despise. Who is who? Who will make it to the engagement ceremony in six weeks?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
在本季最新的相亲节目中，我们的单身汉将与他们注定要爱的两个人相匹配，而另一个他们注定要鄙视的人。谁是谁？六周后谁将参加订婚仪式？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
